_comment: Layout, sizing and typography for tabs. Colours come from the Figma colour mirror; these do not, so they are authored here. Figma sets: horizontal-tabs-underline (14370:9654) and horizontal-tabs_button (14370:9710).

base._source: height and badge-size are fixed pixel dimensions read off the Figma frames; no semantic token backs them (semantic.iconography.sizes are still 'tbd' in design.md), so they stay literal.

_verified_from.scope: variant lists for all three sets, depth-3 walk of the first variant of each, plus a browser measurement of the rendered underline tabs
_verified_from.result: Underline: root 40 with a 1px bottom rule in `tabs-fg-disable`; item 40 with padding 8/16 and an 8px internal gap; the selected item takes a 2px bottom rule in `Border-Primary`; labels 14/22 Medium — #E32321 when selected, #262626 otherwise. Button: container radius 8 with a 1px accent border, inner row gap 4, item radius 6. Every one of those matches, confirmed in the browser.

corrections.root height: Rendered 41 instead of 40. Figma strokes the bottom rule INSIDE the frame; the container was content-box, so the border was adding to the height. Same mistake ActionBar had.

_figma_gaps.third-set-not-modelled: `tabs-for-orders` (16426:4355) is a third set: same shape as the button style but item padding 4/8 instead of 8/16, and it adds a `desktop=yes|no` axis. The library models the two general sets only. Whether orders needs its own tighter density or should use the shared one is a designer's call, not a build decision.

_figma_icons._comment: The icons Figma instantiates for this component, read 2026-08-20 by walking the instance tree and keeping every main component whose parent set is `icons`. check-figma-icons.py holds the files in `sources` to exactly this set — an extra icon fails as loudly as a missing one, because an extra is one nobody compared. Files not listed in `sources` carry payload a caller passes, not a choice the design makes.

icons.filled-Error-2: the badge dot on `horizontal-tabs-underline` state=select-1 menu=tab-4, on Menu-2 and Menu-4. The other two sets carry no icon.

tokens._source-separator: storybook-local, no Figma token backs it. The underline separator renders #E5E5E5 in Figma and the old tokens.ts labelled it Color/Border/Border-Disable, but semantic.colors.border.disable is #D4D4D4. border.accent.gray-soft-light is the semantic token that actually carries #E5E5E5, so the value stays true to Figma.
